key.name: translucent-top-bar
key.description: Draw the top bar as glass over the wallpaper. It turns solid while a window is maximized.

key.name: show-focused-app-name
key.description: Show the name of the focused app in the top bar.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: The size of the dock's icons: small, medium or large, drawn at 46, 54 and 62 px.

key.name: dock-intellihide
key.summary: Hide the dock behind maximized windows
key.description: Hide the dock while a window overlaps it. Moving the pointer to the bottom edge reveals it.

key.name: dock-running-indicators
key.description: Mark the dock's icons of apps that have open windows.

key.name: dock-show-trash
key.summary: Show the trash in the dock
key.description: Show the trash at the end of the dock.

key.name: window-corner-radius
key.description: The corner radius of app windows, in logical pixels. Maximized, fullscreen and tiled windows are always square. apex-session-agent applies it to GTK 4 apps.

key.name: reduce-transparency
key.description: Replace the glass surfaces of the shell with solid colours.

key.name: layer-enabled
key.description: When false, gnome-shell runs without the Apex layer in this user's sessions: every hook gives its stock value, upstream's stylesheets load, and the colour scheme is stock. It takes effect at the next login. The greeter ignores it. The shell crash guard sets it to false.

key.name: disabled-features
key.description: Features of the Apex layer to leave off without a rebuild, by name: glass, dock, spotlight, lock, motion, notifications, overview, panel, quick-settings, shadows, indicators, polkit and end-session; any other name is refused, and a list with one is refused whole, so the key keeps its previous value. A disabled feature's hooks give their stock values. A change applies at once, in the running session.

key.name: files-details-pane
key.summary: Show the details pane in Files
key.description: Show the details of the selected item beside the Files view.

key.name: files-recent-strip
key.description: Show a strip of recent files above the Files view.

key.name: search-hint-shown
key.description: Set by the shell once it has shown "Press Super+Space to search"; the hint never shows again.

key.name: lower-refresh-rate-on-battery
key.summary: Lower the refresh rate on battery
key.description: apex-session-agent switches the built-in panel to its lowest refresh rate of 60 Hz or more at the current resolution while on battery, and back to the highest rate when plugged in. Settings' Power panel writes it.

key.name: toggle-spotlight
key.description: Open or close Spotlight. Until Spotlight exists it opens the overview's search.
